verdict.rationale: Firebase's Firestore Enterprise edition offers a MongoDB-compatible API, letting developers reuse existing MongoDB drivers/tools/ORM ecosystem, which partially satisfies 'standard clients and ORMs' — but this applies only to the Enterprise edition, not the default Firestore or Realtime Database, and no connection-string mechanism is documented anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, ORM support for the standard (non-Enterprise) Firestore/Realtime DB products, and independent/hands-on confirmation that MongoDB drivers actually connect successfully.
